gloss: to jump across, to leap to

definitions.gloss: to jump across, to leap to
definitions.explanation: To move from one place to another by jumping, often across a gap or between elevated surfaces.

definitions.gloss: to spread (fire, disease), to jump to
definitions.explanation: For something like fire or disease to spread by jumping from one place or host to another.

examples.japanese: {猿|さる}が{木|き}から{木|き}へ{飛|と}び{移|うつ}る。
examples.english: Monkeys leap from tree to tree.

examples.japanese: {船|ふね}から{岸|きし}に{飛|と}び{移|うつ}った。
examples.english: I jumped from the boat to the shore.

examples.japanese: {火|ひ}が{隣|となり}の{家|いえ}に{飛|と}び{移|うつ}った。
examples.english: The fire spread to the neighboring house.

examples.japanese: ウイルスが{新|あたら}しい{宿主|しゅくしゅ}に{飛|と}び{移|うつ}る。
examples.english: The virus jumps to a new host.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: {飛|と}ぶ (to fly, jump) + {移|うつ}る (to move, transfer) = to jump and move to another place

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive. Uses に or へ to mark the destination, and から to mark the origin.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{木|き}から{木|き}へ{飛|と}び{移|うつ}る (to leap from tree to tree)
・{火|ひ}が{飛|と}び{移|うつ}る (fire spreads)
・{屋根|やね}から{屋根|やね}へ{飛|と}び{移|うつ}る (to jump from roof to roof)

USAGE NOTE: In sense 2, this verb is commonly used in news and scientific contexts to describe the spread of fire or infectious diseases.

RELATED {飛|と}び～ COMPOUND VERBS:
・{飛|と}び{上|あ}がる - to jump up
・{飛|と}び{込|こ}む - to jump into, to dive in
・{飛|と}び{出|だ}す - to jump out, to rush out
・{飛|と}び{越|こ}える - to jump over
